overall_quality.reason: Accurate, clear, relevant explanation of eventual consistency with practical context.
overall_quality.evidence: Eventual consistency is a property of distributed systems where all nodes will eventually agree on the state of the system, but not necessarily in real-time. This means that after a write operation, it may take some time for all nodes to reflect the change, and during that period, reads might return stale data. The system guarantees that if no new updates are made, all nodes will eventually converge to the same state.
